Într-un proces politrop, mărimea care ră: In a polytropic process, the quantity that stays constant is…
Prin definiție, procesul politrop are că: By definition, a polytropic process has constant molar heat capacity C. The amount ν is also constant in a closed system, but the defining condition is C = constant.
Legea după care se desfășoară procesul p: The law governing a polytropic process is…
Legea politrope este pVⁿ = constant, und: The polytropic law is pVⁿ = constant, where n is the polytropic exponent. Other forms follow from the ideal-gas equation.
Pentru n = 0, pV⁰ = p = constant: proces: For n = 0, pV⁰ = p = constant: an isobaric process. The molar heat capacity is C_p.
Pentru n = 1, pV = constant: proces izot: For n = 1, pV = constant: an isothermal process. ΔU = 0, so Q = L; work is calculated using the logarithm, not equation (5).
Pentru n = γ, căldura schimbată cu exter: For n = γ, the heat exchanged with the surroundings is…
La adiabată Q = 0. Atunci ΔU = −L: gazul: For an adiabatic process Q = 0. Thus ΔU = −L: the gas cools during expansion and warms during compression.
Când n → ±∞, procesul politrop tinde spr: As n → ±∞, the polytropic process approaches…
În limita n → ±∞, volumul rămâne constan: In the limit n → ±∞, volume stays constant: an isochoric process. Work is zero and C → C_V.
Pentru n ≠ 1, lucrul mecanic al politrop: For n ≠ 1, the work done in a polytropic process is…
Relația (5) este L = −νRΔT/(n−1). Semnul: Equation (5) is L = −νRΔT/(n−1). The sign matters: during expansion ΔT is negative for n > 1, so L is positive.
Procesul liniar p = k·V are indicele pol: The linear process p = k·V has polytropic exponent…
pV⁻¹ = constant se rescrie p = k·V. Este: pV⁻¹ = constant can be written p = k·V. This is the linear process, with C = (C_p + C_V)/2.
Relația dintre n și căldura molară C est: The relation between n and molar heat capacity C is…
Din Q = ΔU + L și relația Robert Mayer s: Q = ΔU + L and Mayer’s relation give n = (C − C_p)/(C − C_V), equivalent to C = (C_p − nC_V)/(1−n).
Un mol de gaz diatomic suferă o încălzir: One mole of a diatomic gas is heated isobarically with ΔT = 60 K. The work is approximately…
L = pΔV = νRΔT = 1 × 8.314 × 60 ≈ 499 J. For comparison, Q = νC_pΔT ≈ 1 746 J and ΔU ≈ 1 247 J.
